title: GBAutomation Monthly, May 2026
author: Greg
summary: Roll-up of four weekly TAC reports. Client portal validation closed out the month. Mall Scanner went live.

sections.heading: Headline
bullets: Validated the reusable tenant portal end to end on the GBAutomation template.
Mall Scanner moved from prototype to scheduled cycle. Hermes alerts wired.
UI Agent now bridges the ui-agents repo into this site.

sections.heading: What shipped
bullets: Tenant portal scaffold under /clients/gbautomation with apps, artifacts, reports.
Apps registry consolidated. Six apps live, two private.
Surface taxonomy for the website published at /ui-agent.

sections.heading: Looking ahead
bullets: Promote the boxed-icon header to the shared PageHeader primitive.
Onboard the first external tenant. Use this portal as the template.
Backfill testimonials, about, blog, and calculator surfaces from trees.yaml.
